title: HelmGuard raises $7.3m to for agentic GRC platform
summary: HelmGuard has raised $7.3 million in seed funding for its platform that uses AI agents to automate governance, risk and compliance in regulated sectors such as financial services.
content: HelmGuard has successfully raised $7.3 million in seed funding to develop its innovative agentic governance, risk, and compliance platform. The funding will support the company's efforts to deploy AI agents that automate complex compliance processes, specifically targeting highly regulated industries such as financial services.

title: US Bank pilots custom-built stablecoin
summary: US Bank has executed of a live intrabank pilot transaction between North America and Europe that utilised the bank's proprietary US dollar-backed stablecoin, USBDC.
content: US Bank has successfully completed a live intrabank pilot transaction spanning North America and Europe. The transfer utilized USBDC, the bank's proprietary, custom-built, US dollar-backed stablecoin. This milestone represents a significant step for traditional financial institutions exploring blockchain technology for cross-border payments and internal settlement processes.

title: World Bank targets more digital payments in emerging markets
summary: Mastercard and Visa are backing a new World Bank risk sharing initiative to help local financial institutions expand digital payments in emerging markets.
content: The World Bank is launching a new risk-sharing initiative aimed at increasing digital payments in emerging markets. Major payment companies Mastercard and Visa are supporting the project, which is designed to help local financial institutions expand their digital payment infrastructure and services in developing regions.

title: Trezor says third-party security breach led to phishing emails from legitimate domain
summary: This follows last month's security breach at shipping provider ShipMonk, which exposed the personal information of Trezor customers.
content: Hardware wallet provider Trezor reported a third-party security breach that resulted in phishing emails being sent to customers from a legitimate domain. The incident follows a data breach last month at shipping provider ShipMonk, which exposed personal information belonging to Trezor customers. Security incidents of this nature often increase the risk of targeted phishing attacks against cryptocurrency users.

content: A new memecoin called LAPTOP, launched by Hunter Biden to counter token scams, resulted in heavy financial losses for the majority of its traders. Data from Bubblemaps indicates that nearly 80 percent of investors lost money within hours of the token's release, with only a small fraction securing profits.

title: Bitcoin Open Interest climbs before CPI – Is $82K next for BTC?
summary: Despite evidence of long-term holders taking profits and selling into bullish strength, the BTC price continued to hold up well above the $76k demand zone.
content: Bitcoin open interest has risen ahead of upcoming Consumer Price Index data releases, raising questions about whether the cryptocurrency might target the $82,000 level next. Even as some long-term holders secure profits by selling into the current bullish strength, the Bitcoin price has demonstrated resilience, remaining stable well above the key $76,000 demand zone.

title: Iran continues executions despite public pardons, consolidating regime power
summary:
Iran's executions, despite pardons, signal a strategy to deter dissent, reinforcing regime stability and reducing near-term change prospects.
The post Iran continues executions despite public pardons, consolidating regime power appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Iran has continued carrying out executions despite announcements of public pardons. Observers note this strategy is utilized by the regime to deter public dissent and reinforce its internal stability, effectively reducing the near-term prospects for significant political change in the country.

title: US-China trade truce boosts business sentiment among US firms in China
summary:
The trade truce may signal a temporary easing of economic tensions, but unresolved geopolitical issues could still impact future relations.
The post US-China trade truce boosts business sentiment among US firms in China appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A recent trade truce between the United States and China has improved business sentiment for American firms operating within the Chinese market. While this temporary easing of economic tensions offers short-term relief, experts note that unresolved geopolitical challenges could still impact future relations between the two nations.

title: Newsom signs AI safety bills backed by Anthropic, OpenAI
summary:
California's AI regulation leadership may boost industry growth, with market confidence in AI firms like Anthropic reflecting this trend.
The post Newsom signs AI safety bills backed by Anthropic, OpenAI appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: California Governor Gavin Newsom has signed new artificial intelligence safety bills into law. The legislation has gained notable backing from major industry players, including prominent AI firms Anthropic and OpenAI. Observers suggest these regulatory developments could influence the broader technology sector and shape future market confidence in artificial intelligence firms operating within the region.

title: Brent crude tops $101 as Middle East conflict escalates
summary:
Rising Brent crude prices signal potential global economic instability due to increased geopolitical tensions affecting energy markets.
The post Brent crude tops $101 as Middle East conflict escalates appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Brent crude oil prices have surpassed $101 per barrel as escalating conflict in the Middle East intensifies concerns over global energy supplies. The sharp increase in commodity prices highlights growing geopolitical tensions in the region, raising fears of potential disruptions to international oil markets and broader economic instability.

title: Credolab on Taking Behavioural Credit Scoring into FICO Platform
summary:

The post Credolab on Taking Behavioural Credit Scoring into FICO Platform appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Credolab, co-founded by Michele Tucci, has secured a listing on the FICO Marketplace. This development brings behavioural credit scoring into the FICO platform, offering lenders new tools to evaluate creditworthiness while defining the scope and limitations of the behavioural data collected.

title: Crypto market gains 17.6% – Why $421B perp volume raises a red flag
summary: Crypto enters September with strong institutional demand, but the rally faces a key macro test.
content: The cryptocurrency market surged by 17.6%, driven by strong institutional demand as September began. However, a massive perp volume of $421 billion has raised concerns among analysts. This sudden rally now faces a critical macroeconomic test, leaving market participants watchful of potential volatility ahead.
